content:
SECTION 1

* Young people today are often criticized by older generations for spending money on things like holidays or eating out, instead of saving up to buy a house.
* It's very hard for young people in the UK to afford buying a home because property prices are high and banks are less willing to give loans.
* Many young people feel like they will never be able to own their own home and will always have to rent from others.
* Older people who own properties sometimes complain that young people are irresponsible with money, even though young people are actually struggling.
* Wages for people under 25 are especially low, and many have insecure jobs like zero-hours contracts, making it even harder to save money or afford to buy a house.
